title: SENT TOMORROW · Part 4
gemini_style: scared teenage girl telling it fast, close to the mic, tense and real

vo_open.text: The woman on the stairs was Mom. The real one.
vo_open.cap: The woman on the stairs was *Mom.* The *real* one.
vo_open.de: Die Frau auf der Treppe war Mama. Die echte.
vo_open.es: La mujer de la escalera era mamá. La de verdad.
vo_open.fr: La femme dans l’escalier, c’était maman. La vraie.
vo_open.tts: The woman on the stairs was Mom. <short pause> The REAL one.
vo_open.style: breathless, fast, relieved and scared at once

vo.text: She was shaking. She showed me a text. From me. Don't trust Maya.
vo.cap: She was *shaking.* She showed me a text. From *me.* Don't trust *Maya.*
vo.de: Sie zitterte. Sie zeigte mir eine Nachricht. Von mir. Trau Maya nicht.
vo.es: Estaba temblando. Me enseñó un mensaje. Mío. No confíes en Maya.
vo.fr: Elle tremblait. Elle m’a montré un message. De moi. Ne fais pas confiance à Maya.
vo.tts: She was shaking. She showed me a text... from ME. <short pause> Don't trust Maya.

vo.text: I never sent that. Then both our phones buzzed. She's already inside.
vo.cap: I never *sent* that. Then *both* our phones buzzed. She's *already inside.*
vo.de: Das habe ich nie geschickt. Dann summten beide Handys. Sie ist schon drin.
vo.es: Yo nunca lo envié. Entonces vibraron los dos móviles. Ya está dentro.
vo.fr: Je ne l’ai jamais envoyé. Puis nos deux téléphones ont vibré. Elle est déjà à l’intérieur.
vo.tts: I never sent that. <gasp> Then BOTH our phones buzzed. <short pause> She's already inside.

vo.text: Mom grabbed my hand and we ran.
vo.cap: Mom grabbed my hand and we *ran.*
vo.de: Mama packte meine Hand und wir rannten.
vo.es: Mamá me agarró la mano y corrimos.
vo.fr: Maman m’a pris la main et on a couru.
vo.tts: <heavy breath> Mom grabbed my hand and we RAN.

vo.text: But in the window, my reflection wasn't running. It was smiling.
vo.cap: But in the window, my reflection *wasn't* running. It was *smiling.*
vo.de: Aber im Fenster rannte mein Spiegelbild nicht. Es lächelte.
vo.es: Pero en la ventana, mi reflejo no corría. Sonreía.
vo.fr: Mais dans la vitre, mon reflet ne courait pas. Il souriait.
vo.tts: But in the window... <short pause> my reflection wasn't running. <breath> It was smiling.
